# orionbelt_users (Data Source)

List users matching every filter given, sorted by username. With no filters, lists every user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "orionbelt_users" "operators" {
  role = "operator"
}

output "operators_without_mfa" {
  value = [for u in data.orionbelt_users.operators.users : u.username if !u.mfa_enabled]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `role` (String) Only users with this role: admin, operator, auditor or user.
- `username_prefix` (String) Only users whose username starts with this.

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `mfa_enabled` (Boolean)
- `role` (String)
- `username` (String)
